title: Draw EER layout file
description: Positions of the elements of a Draw EER diagram, saved when shapes are dragged in the preview. Elements listed here never move when the text changes; new ones are placed around them and added. Written by the extension.

nodes.description: Entities and relationships: the center of each, in px.

attributes.description: Attributes: where each sits relative to the center of its owner (its shape, or the composite attribute it is part of), in px.
